purpose: Provides two 3D Slicer modules to compute Functional Tumor Volume (FTV) from breast DCE-MRI exams.
summary: The Breast_DCEMRI_FTV extension provides two well-structured 3D Slicer scripted modules for computing breast functional tumor volume (FTV) from DCE-MRI exams. Code quality, safety, packaging, and licensing meet standard requirements, with only a minor recommendation to use opencv-python-headless rather than opencv-python to avoid potential Qt conflicts in Slicer.

safety.rationale: No malicious behavior, telemetry, or dangerous command injections found. Package installation helper uses standard slicer.util.pip_install / pip_ensure.

environment.rationale: pyproject.toml lists opencv-python instead of opencv-python-headless.

packaging.rationale: CMakeLists.txt and module CMakeLists.txt properly package Python scripts and resources.

soundness.rationale: Scripted modules follow standard Slicer structure and CMake build setup.

utility.rationale: Provides specialized DCE-MRI breast FTV segmentation and reporting tools with comprehensive documentation.

findings.title: Use opencv-python-headless instead of opencv-python
findings.explanation: opencv-python bundles its own GUI/Qt libraries which can conflict with Slicer's bundled Qt libraries. Extensions should use opencv-python-headless instead.
findings.suggestion: Change opencv-python to opencv-python-headless in pyproject.toml.

not_checked: Full execution of DCE-MRI pipeline on clinical data
